:::{#exm-prime}
#### Primes and non-primes

- $7$ is [prime](#def-prime):
  none of $2$, $3$, $4$, $5$ and $6$ [divides](#def-divides) $7$,
  and no [integer](#def-integers) above $7$ does,
  so its only positive divisors are $1$ and $7$.
- $9$ is not prime,
  because $3$ divides $9$.
- $1$ is not prime,
  because the definition requires $n \ge 2$.
